review_runs.summary: Selected source stays on concept, explains placement and noun-form pairing, and develops practice into contextual writing. All endorsed Norwegian forms are valid Bokmål. Main defect: two contrast-choice tasks reject postposed possessives even though those forms can express the requested owner contrast. Smaller weaknesses concern unglossed terminology, level-related wording, and missing spaces in completions. Reviewed all 13 exercises. Each serves obj-possessive-placement-01 through possessive placement, matching definite or indefinite noun forms, interpreting owner contrast versus neutral information, or explaining and applying these patterns. Focused phrase-completion and repair tasks test valid subskills; none relies on shared vocabulary alone.
